confidence_notes: Current Glasgow cost-of-living data supports restaurant meals, cappuccino and draft beer. Cocktail and wine evidence is thinner; those estimates use local menu levels relative to draft beer. Accommodation figures are broad estimates with substantial seasonal and event variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Glasgow-specific city data. Accommodation estimates reflect Glasgow as a major UK regional city, broadly comparable with Liverpool and below central London, with university and event demand.
